Alex K: Customer (Acme Mobile) flagged a billing spike on 2026-02-15 — invoice shows ~1,200 extra tokens compared to dashboard. They saw a 503 during an upload and then the SDK retried. Can someone triage?
Maria S: Can you paste the request ids / trace ids and any client logs?
Alex K: Here are the bits from the mobile logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-02-15T14:02:11Z] request_id=rx-9c1a trace=tr-77a2 status=503
[2026-02-15T14:02:11Z] sdk retry triggered (auth refresh)
[2026-02-15T14:02:11Z] request_id=rx-9c1b trace=tr-77a2 status=200
headers_sent: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\n# NOTE: Idempotency-Key missing on second attempt (race on header set)
```
Alex K: Customer says mobile SDK v1.4.2, happening intermittently during token refresh under poor connectivity.
Rahul P: Found matching traces at the gateway. We received two requests with same trace tr-77a2 within 200ms. Upstream saw both as separate calls because second request lacked Idempotency-Key header. Metering shows two ledger writes: `usage_write_id: uw-833, uw-834` for the same session.
Rahul P: Quick query output: 
```
SELECT id, trace, idempotency_key, tokens FROM metering WHERE trace='tr-77a2';
-- id: uw-833 trace: tr-77a2 idempotency_key: NULL tokens: 540
-- id: uw-834 trace: tr-77a2 idempotency_key: NULL tokens: 660
```
Maria S: Repro steps from our side: 1) force SDK token refresh mid-request, 2) simulate 503 on first upstream call, 3) SDK retry path sends follow-up without idempotency header when refresh completes. Seen in emulator.
Maria S: Root cause: race in SDK where header population waits on async token refresh and retry path forgets to reattach Idempotency-Key.
Billing Ops: What's the customer impact and suggested remediation?
Alex K: Impact: double-counted tokens for that request window (total ~1,200 tokens). We created support ticket TKT-3421 and proposed a credit for the full delta. Customer asked for a short RCA and timeline for a fix.
Rahul P: Mitigation: gateway policy updated to treat repeated requests with same trace and within 1s as potential replays and tag for manual review (deployed 14:40 UTC). Not a long-term fix but reduces blast radius.
Maria S: Code fix ready: ensure SDK attaches Idempotency-Key synchronously before any retry path and preserve key across auth refresh. PR: mobile-sdk#512, will ship v1.4.3.
Support Bot: Created ticket TKT-3421 and aliased to billing case BILL-987.
Billing Ops: Issued credit: 1,200 tokens applied to Acme Mobile invoice 2026-02-15. Customer notified. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: Follow-ups: patch rollout to mobile channels scheduled (gradual rollout 4h), add unit tests for retry header path, and add a non-idempotent-retry alert to our billing monitor. Closing thread once v1.4.3 is live and customer confirms. :thumbsup:
